name: ALM4DataverseSetConnectionVariables
description: Sets BuildTools.* variables and optionally AZURE_* environment variables to provide custom script tasks access to use the Service Connection as a single source of truth. Supports WorkloadIdentityFederation with enhanced Azure DevOps compatibility and automatic Azure SDK integration.
author: ALM4Dataverse
helpMarkDown: Sets pipeline variables from Power Platform service connection. Supports WorkloadIdentityFederation, Service Principal with client secret, and username/password authentication. Can automatically configure Azure SDK environment variables for seamless DefaultAzureCredential integration with enhanced Azure DevOps compatibility.

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.EnvironmentUrl
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Environment URL used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.ApplicationId
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Application Id used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.ClientSecret
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Client Secret used by Service Connection (only for ClientSecret auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.TenantId
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Tenant Id used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.DataverseConnectionString
outputVariables.description: Output variable of a Dataverse connection string based on values used by Service Connection

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.UserName
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Username used by Service Connection (only for username/password auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.Password
outputVariables.description: Output variable of Password used by Service Connection (only for username/password auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.IdTokenRequestUrl
outputVariables.description: Output variable of the OIDC token request URL (only for WorkloadIdentityFederation auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.AdoIdTokenRequestUrl
outputVariables.description: Output variable for PAC_ADO_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL environment variable (only for WorkloadIdentityFederation auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.AdoIdTokenRequestToken
outputVariables.description: Output variable for PAC_ADO_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN (Azure DevOps OAuth token, only for WorkloadIdentityFederation auth)

outputVariables.name: BuildTools.AuthenticationType
outputVariables.description: Output variable indicating the authentication type used (WorkloadIdentityFederation, ClientSecret, or UsernamePassword)

inputs.name: authenticationType
inputs.label: Authentication type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Choose the authentication method for connecting to Power Platform.

inputs.name: PowerPlatformEnvironment
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authenticate with your Power Platform environment with username/password. Does not support MFA.

inputs.name: PowerPlatformSPN
inputs.label: Service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Authenticate with your Power Platform environment with an Azure AppID, tenantID and client secret or WorkloadIdentityFederation.

inputs.name: Environment
inputs.label: Environment Url
inputs.helpMarkDown: Environment url this task targets; default is the pipeline variable that e.g. the CreateEnvironment task has set before.

inputs.name: ApplicationId
inputs.label: Application Id
inputs.helpMarkDown: Application Id to use to login.

inputs.name: RedirectUri
inputs.label: Redirect Uri
inputs.helpMarkDown: Redirect URI of the specified App. Needed when specifying an App Id.

inputs.name: setAzureEnvironmentVariables
inputs.label: Set Azure environment variables
inputs.helpMarkDown: Set AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables and Azure Pipelines-specific variables (AZURESUBSCRIPTION_*) for automatic authentication with Azure SDK's DefaultAzureCredential and AzurePipelinesCredential. When enabled, tools using Azure CLI, PowerShell Az modules, and .NET applications will automatically authenticate without code changes.
